description: Implementation of the AddressList class managing network address collections, including creation, duplication, alias handling, and logging.

classes.name: AddressList
classes.description: Manages a list of network addresses with associated DNS aliases, supporting creation, duplication, and deduplication.

methods.name: AddressList(const IPEndPoint&)
methods.description: Constructs AddressList with a single endpoint.

methods.name: AddressList(const IPEndPoint&, std::vector<std::string>)
methods.description: Constructs AddressList with an endpoint and DNS aliases.

methods.name: AddressList(std::vector<IPEndPoint>)
methods.description: Constructs AddressList from a vector of endpoints.

methods.name: CreateFromIPAddress
methods.description: Creates AddressList from an IPAddress and port.

methods.name: CreateFromIPAddressList
methods.description: Creates AddressList from a list of IPAddresses and aliases.

methods.name: CopyWithPort
methods.description: Copies an AddressList with a specified port.

methods.name: SetDefaultCanonicalName
methods.description: Sets default canonical name based on the first endpoint.

methods.name: SetDnsAliases
methods.description: Sets DNS aliases, resetting if input is empty string.

methods.name: NetLogParams
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of network log parameters.

methods.name: Deduplicate
methods.description: Removes duplicate addresses from the list.
